title: Cost Management and Token Optimization
query: Your function-calling system sends 100k function schemas (50 functions × 2k tokens each) in every API call. At $3/1M input tokens, this costs $0.60 per query. How can you reduce cost by 90%?

options.text: Use prompt caching to reuse function schema tokens across queries
Implement dynamic tool selection: send only relevant functions per query
Compress function descriptions to use fewer tokens
All of the above in combination

explanation: Cost optimization requires MULTIPLE STRATEGIES: (1) PROMPT CACHING: Anthropic/OpenAI cache static content (function schemas). First call pays full cost, subsequent calls: ~90% discount on cached tokens. (2) DYNAMIC TOOL SELECTION: Classify query → send only 5-10 relevant functions instead of all 50 (80-90% token reduction). (3) COMPRESS DESCRIPTIONS: Remove redundant words, use abbreviations (10-30% reduction). Combined: 95%+ cost reduction while maintaining functionality.
learning_points: Token costs scale with: # functions × description size × query volume
Prompt caching: huge savings for static content (function schemas)
Dynamic selection: only send functions relevant to query category
Compression: shorter descriptions, remove examples from schema
Monitor: track tokens per query, cost per query, cache hit rate

prompt_caching.how: Mark function schemas as cacheable content
prompt_caching.savings: 90% discount on cached tokens after first call
prompt_caching.best_for: Static function definitions that rarely change
prompt_caching.gotcha: Cache invalidates on any schema change

dynamic_tool_selection.how: Classify query intent → send subset of functions
dynamic_tool_selection.example: Query about calendar → send only calendar functions (5), not all (50)
dynamic_tool_selection.tradeoff: Might miss relevant function if classification wrong

schema_compression.gotcha: Don't sacrifice clarity - test selection accuracy

other_optimizations: Use smaller models for function selection (GPT-4o-mini vs GPT-4)
Implement semantic caching for repeated queries
Use structured output mode (reduces parsing tokens)

with_optimizations.prompt_caching: 90% of function tokens cached → $0.06 per query
with_optimizations.dynamic_selection: Send 5 functions instead of 50 → $0.006 per query

monitoring_metrics: Tool selection accuracy (are we sending the right functions?)
